address: Chemin de Saint-Blaise (Les Imberts), Gordes, 84220, France
bio: Alexis Osmont’s market-inspired cuisine is as spontaneous as the old farmhouse seems timeless. Let yourself be transported into Alexis’ creative and culinary universe – he cannot be rivalled for his knack for enhancing the treasures of the Vaucluse: asparagus, girolle mushrooms, artichoke…...
